audit_name: Day 22 Checkpoint 022 Theoretical Evolution Audit (H02 & F24)

h02_audit.model_formalism: One high-j quasiparticle coupled to a triaxial rotor preserving total angular momentum I
h02_audit.anharmonicity: Calculated B(E2) values show substantial non-harmonic deviations from n-scaling; n_w=2,3 are traced asymptotic model labels rather than exact linear bosons
h02_audit.cranking_crossover: At sufficiently high spin, the collective wobbling regime crosses over into the cranking-like regime due to pairing and inertia competition
h02_audit.tripartite_fingerprint: Joint presence of: (1) similar moments of inertia, (2) similar alignments, and (3) strong Delta-I=1 E2 links with signature-dependent phase; no single observable is sufficient
h02_audit.relevance_to_low_spin: Hamamoto 2002 explicitly cautioned that simple rotor-particle calculations omit pairing attenuation and spin-dependent inertia variations

cone_topology.TW: Precession cone and particle j aligned along short/long axis, perpendicular to intermediate axis (maximum MoI)
cone_topology.LW: Precession cone aligned along intermediate axis (maximum MoI)
cone_topology.FM: Flip mode across separatrix dividing TW and LW regimes

critical_instability.implication: Transverse wobbling frequency decreases with spin and hits zero at J_c; harmonic RPA diverges near J_c
critical_instability.low_spin_paradox: In A~130 nuclei (e.g. 135Pr), J_c ~ 14.4 hbar occurs near I ~ 29/2 hbar, exactly in the middle of the observed sequence, causing early instability

audit_rebuttal: Zero partner-resolved lifetimes measured across entire A~130 region
135Pr proven M1-dominated (88% M1) by Lv 2022 JuroGam II P-Rac
187Au proven M1-dominated (94% M1) and 188Pt impurity by Guo 2022
136Nd 751 keV link proven 81.3% M1-dominated, with 11-fold DSAM B(E2) collapse at I=17->18
Small-angle parameter f(n,I) ~ 0.5-1.5 universally fails f << 1 in normal-deformed nuclei due to slow core rotation R ~ 1-3 hbar
